purpose: Pilot movement evidence and field-review queue. These are scoped observations, not whole-route approvals or a replacement for the source snapshot.
default_profile: ordinary passenger car on a through trip
method: Review scoped CDOT drawings, alderman updates and the local OSM snapshot. Record document dates, inspected pages and hashes where available. Plans, anticipated dates, broad completion labels and expired construction notices do not establish current movement. Source-record and geographic bindings keep context local; manual Street View links are navigation aids.
